plugins.name: product-team
plugins.description: A coordinated product team as 33 skills: 23 role perspectives, an 8-skill delivery pipeline, a router that picks the right role, squad or workflow, and a Project Point of Truth practice for durable product knowledge. Includes a gate-enforcement hook; the optional CLAUDE.md routing brain is installed separately with install.sh.
